scripts.title: Killaura
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- kill all (Human Team), killaura (Transfured Team)

-------------- clean old connections --------------
if getgenv().connections then
    for i, conn in pairs(getgenv().connections) do
        if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
        getgenv().connections[i] = nil
    end
end

---------- vars ----------
local getservice, findfirstchild, findfirstchildofclass = game.GetService, game.FindFirstChild, game.FindFirstChildOfClass
local replicatedstorage, players, runservice = getservice(game, "ReplicatedStorage"), getservice(game, "Players"), getservice(game, "RunService")
local localplayer = players.LocalPlayer

---------- anti cheat bypass ----------
do
    local remotesfolder = replicatedstorage.DLW_ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
    local anticheat_eventnames =
    {
    	"DetectedNoClip",
    	"DetectedPlatform",
    	"DetectedSpeedHack",
    }

    for _, eventname in anticheat_eventnames do
        local remote = findfirstchild(remotesfolder, eventname)
        if not remote then continue end
        remote:Destroy()
    end
end

getgenv().connections = {}

getgenv().connections.killaura = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for _, player in players:GetPlayers() do
        if not player then continue end ; if player == localplayer then continue end ; if player.Team == localplayer.Team then continue end
        local character = player.Character

        local hitpart = findfirstchild(character, "HumanoidRootPart") ; if not hitpart then continue end
        local localcharacter = localplayer.Character ; if not localcharacter then continue end
        local tool = findfirstchildofclass(localcharacter, "Tool") ; if not tool then continue end

        if localplayer.Team.Name ~= "Human" then
            local humanoid = findfirstchild(character, "Humanoid") ; if not humanoid then continue end
            local hitposition = hitpart.Position

            local remote = findfirstchild(tool, "Remote") ; if not remote then continue end
            local hitEvent = findfirstchild(remote, "Hit") ; if not hitEvent then continue end

            hitEvent:FireServer(hitpart, humanoid, hitposition)
        else
            local ApplyDamageEvent = findfirstchild(tool, "ApplyDamage") ; if not ApplyDamageEvent then continue end
            ApplyDamageEvent:FireServer(hitpart)
        end
    end
end)
